description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger Your marked target uses an action you can see.

You learn what that action was before it resolves — the spell, the manoeuvre, the ability — and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC and saving throw against it. If it targets someone other than you, an ally of your choice within 30 feet gains that bonus instead.

cinderfall.incomplete: On the mark using a visible action: learn the action before it resolves; +2 circumstance to AC/save against it, or redirect that bonus to an ally within 30 feet. No rule element grants foreknowledge of a resolving action's identity, and the ally-redirect branch has no selector reaching a different creature's own roll -- compounded by the confirmed-unfireable mark predicate.
